query:
SELECT
            l.id,
            l.sync_generation
        FROM
            email_links l
            JOIN email_messages m ON m.link_id = l.id
        WHERE
            m.id = $1
            AND m.thread_id = $2
            AND l.id = ANY ($3)
            AND l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK', 'IMAP')
            AND ($4::text = l.macro_id
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        macro_user_links u
                    WHERE
                        u.link_id = l.id
                        AND u.primary_macro_id = $4))
            FOR SHARE OF l
